title: The Guards Are Bribed at the Tomb
description: After Jesus' resurrection, some of the guards go to the chief priests and report what has happened. The chief priests and elders hold a meeting and bribe the soldiers with a large sum of money to say that the disciples stole Jesus' body while they were asleep. They also promise to persuade the governor if he hears about it. The soldiers accept the money, and the rumor of the theft spreads among the Jews to this day. [ref:Matt 28:11-15|Matthew 28:11-15]
